junction.name: 8 Avenue & West 49 Street, New York City

claims.text: 8 Avenue & West 49 Street had 54 injury crashes in police records since 2021-10-31: 23 pedestrians injured, 16 cyclists injured and 0 people killed.
At the U.S. DOT's values that harm costs about $3.7 million a year.
29% of crashes here involved a two-wheeler, against 16% at the city's priority junctions.
15% of crashes here had a cyclist hurt, against 7% at the city's priority junctions.

The city's Leading Pedestrian Interval signals: passed the causal gate (pedestrian injury crashes changed -17% (95% interval -22% to -11%) at 1,651 sites against sites treated later or the citywide trend, and a placebo date shows nothing).
The city's turn traffic calming: earlier trend (a simple before/after says -26%, but a placebo date before the work shows a drop too, so the decline cannot be credited to the program).
The city's enhanced crossings: not shown (at 96 sites the change in pedestrian injury crashes (-7%, 95% interval -50% to +69%) could be zero).
The city's speed humps: not shown (at 1,008 sites the change in injury crashes (+0%, 95% interval -9% to +9%) could be zero).

Backplates with Retroreflective Borders would avoid about 1.6 crashes a year (CMF 1410, the record FHWA's fact sheet cites; evidence: only if a site check confirms it), worth $555,000 a year; check on site: an entry on yellow or red.

Yellow Change Intervals would avoid about 0.8 crashes a year (CMF 4219, the more conservative of the two middle records of 4; evidence: only if a site check confirms it), worth $288,000 a year; check on site: an entry on yellow or red; the current yellow plus all-red time is below the ITE recommended practice.
The NYC Department of Transportation (NYC DOT) is responsible for 8 Avenue, West 49 Street (not listed in NYSDOT Roadway Inventory, so a city street).
Who can push for it: Council Member, District 3, New York City Council; Manhattan Community Board 5.
A request letter to the NYC Department of Transportation (NYC DOT) is ready to draft from these facts.
